answer: Make each new identity pay to be seen. Before an agent joins, it must solve a hashing puzzle whose difficulty climbs with the fleet's growth rate, like holding up a lantern that burns real fuel to appear on the roster. A thousand sybils then cost a thousand puzzles, not one shared trick. An honest newcomer pays once; an attacker carving onyx-hard clones pays per face, so the economics stay flat all the way to the horizon instead of collapsing under free duplicates.
